items.title: OpenSSL Fixes High-Severity DTLS Flaw That Can Leak Heap Memory Unencrypted
items.summary: A High-severity OpenSSL flaw can leak heap memory to the other side of a DTLS connection or crash the program, OpenSSL said on September 29 as it released fixes. DTLS, the TLS variant used for UDP traffic, resends a handshake message if no reply arrives before the timer expires.
items.author: Swati Khandelwal
